description: Send a transactional email via Brevo (POST /smtp/email). This SENDS to outside recipients immediately — confirm recipients and content with the human first. Required: to (array of { email, name }), and either templateId (with optional params) or subject + htmlContent/textContent. Optional: sender ({ name, email } — must be a verified Brevo sender; default from the template), cc, bcc, replyTo ({ email }), params, attachment (array of { url } or { content (base64), name }), tags, headers, scheduledAt.

attachment.description: Attachments as array of { url } or { content (base64), name }

headers.description: Additional email headers as key-value pairs

params.description: Template parameters filled into the template

scheduledAt.description: ISO timestamp to send later instead of immediately

sender.description: Sender { name, email }; must be a verified Brevo sender, default from the template

templateId.description: Brevo template ID to send (alternative to subject + content)

to.description: Recipients as array of { email, name }

name: send_brevo_email
